motion.name: dock-proximity
motion.value: scale 1 → 1.12 → 1 over -100px → 0 → 100px; spring mass 0.8, stiffness 300, damping 32
motion.purpose: Pointer response for icons only; disabled with coarse pointer or reduced motion.

components.description: Outlined filter with explicit pressed state.
components.css: .ds-filter{font-family:-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:.5rem;min-height:2.75rem;padding:.625rem 1rem;border:1px solid transparent;border-radius:9px;font-size:.8125rem;font-weight:600;line-height:1.4;cursor:pointer;transition:background-color 160ms ease-out,color 160ms ease-out;min-height:2.5rem;padding:.5rem .75rem;background:transparent;color:var(--muted);border-color:var(--line);font-weight:500;}.ds-filter[aria-pressed=true]{background:var(--accent-soft);color:#0052a6;border-color:#b9d4f4;}.ds-filter:hover{background:#e9ebf0;color:var(--ink);}.ds-filter:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--focus, #006bdb);outline-offset:3px;}.ds-filter:active{transform:scale(.98);}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-filter{transition:none;}.ds-filter:active{transform:none;}}

narrative.overview:
A calm document workspace: cool near-white surroundings, graphite text and white work surfaces keep attention on evidence and the next review action. Native system typography and familiar grouped controls implement the confirmed Apple-inspired direction.

Density comes from compact navigation and coherent document groups, with a separate tinted decision area. Translucency belongs to functional navigation; restrained motion responds to pointer proximity without moving link targets.
keyCharacteristics: Cool canvas and white document surfaces.
One blue action accent with semantic status colors.
Compact labelled navigation and persistent focus feedback.
Responsive document groups with readable evidence.

rules.name: The Action Blue Rule
rules.body: Use blue for actions, links and selected navigation; reserve green and red for explicit status or feedback.

rules.name: The Stable Target Rule
rules.body: Animate navigation icons while keeping their link targets and labels stable.

rules.name: The Functional Depth Rule
rules.body: Keep document surfaces flat; use depth for selected controls, navigation and the document editor.

dos: Do use the shared ink, muted text, canvas, surface and blue action colors.
Do keep labels visible on navigation, using the shorter labels on compact screens.
Do preserve the visible keyboard focus ring and static reduced-motion and coarse-pointer navigation.
Do group document content and decisions with clear borders and tonal separation.
donts: Don't add decorative backgrounds or marketing-scale headings to this task workspace.
Don't rely on hover to reveal essential evidence or navigation labels.
Don't scale navigation hit targets with the animated icons.
